notes.title: Guardians of Holme V1.0.0 Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, players! 

The official version of [b]Guardians of Holme[/b] has now been released! In this official 1.0.0 version, we introduce Horus, a new character whose main combat strategy is summoning units, along with new relics, skills, and 27 character-specific cards. We will showcase some of these in our announcement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2086850/_/

We thank our players for their support and feedback during the Early Access phase, which has helped us continually release updates and fix game bugs. We've also optimized various aspects such as UI, graphics, and controls. You can view the details of previous updates in our prior patch notes.

[h1]New Character[/h1]

As the third hero of "Guardians of Holme," Horus, a high-ranking general of the kingdom and partner of Seth, is about to make his debut. He has a unique deck capable of summoning various combat units, commanding powerful Valkyries and Berserkers to fight for him, and can also use the power of alchemy to severely damage enemies. His addition will bring more variability to your battles.

[h1]Featured Cards[/h1]

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681850/5d4cbf6105825795227b057b7a8ec6f4d0609d12.png[/img]
[*] Shield Guard's Mark: High health unit capable of blocking enemies with a shield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681850/e863a3c3797fa0d0687de5ca356b7ae25209019b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681850/32b6b767e675ca2c5380da78fb51fa21eae1291f.png[/img]
[*] Valkyrie's Mark: Valkyries are powerful and summoned when allied units die
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681850/7cad96feb079bfc82fded24b3261ae94f14ba0ad.png[/img]
[*] Berserker's Mark: A warrior who becomes stronger as the battle progresses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681850/49493d3c7e1451e3e6394e93d17b4308479f0558.png[/img]

[/list]

notes.title: V0.10.13 Patch Note - Endless Mode
notes.content:
[h1]Endless Mode[/h1]
A brand new mode, Endless Mode, is now available. In Endless Mode, the difficulty conditions will be divided by seasons. In Endless Mode, the game will not end after defeating the boss in Chapter 3, but will continue into a new round of the game. With each new round, the difficulty conditions of Endless Mode will stack. Just as the name suggests, the game will not actively end, and players will challenge their limits in continuously increasing difficulty. Similar to daily challenges, Endless Mode will also exist in a seasonal leaderboard format, where every player can compete for high scores.

notes.content:
[h1]New Relics[/h1]

[h3]Deerclops Eyeball[/h3]
When an enemy dies while Frozen, deal damage equal to 10% of Max HP to all surrounding enemies. If an enemy dies to this damage, they will be considered to have died while Frozen.

[h3]Nightmare Amulet[/h3]
When picked up, suffer 5 non-fatal damage. Increases the materials required for your traps by ???%, and damage by ???%. The effects of this Relic will increase as the difficulty of the game increases.

[h3]Rotten Flesh[/h3]
Whenever an enemy dies from Burn damage, gain 10 materials.	

[h3]Fatal Bonds[/h3]
Whenever an enemy dies from falling into a pit, deal damage to the enemy on the field with the highest tier, and Slow by 25%. Damage dealt is the higher of 125 or 2% of Max HP.

notes.title: Guardians of Holme will launch Steam Early Access on 16 June!
notes.content:
Hello players! We're happy to announce Steam Early Access of the strategy game Guardians of Holme will be available on June 16, 2023, with a price of 12.99 USD. Additionally, players can enjoy a 20% discount during the first week that you won’t want to miss out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681850/8da8be9add9f6633c3a0e52f0fddc7e5b56e253e.jpg[/img]

Check the trailer here:

[previewyoutube=OTvZR7DCNNA;full][/previewyoutube]

Guardians of Holme is a tower defense game with deckbuilding and rogue-lite elements. Players must use the terrain to their advantage and formulate defensive tactics by strategically placing powerful traps to repel endless waves of enemies. As the game progresses, players can acquire new trap cards, relics, and upgrade existing cards, enhancing their deck and enabling them to face more formidable enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42681850/90b9534d46cd22b4d03bc59613001f640f9602f8.jpg[/img]

In the early access version of Guardians of Holme, players can experience two distinct play styles by choosing between two characters, Seth and Nicole. There are a large number of traps and artifacts make each attempt unique. Whether focusing on maximizing the damage of a single trap, utilizing displacing traps to push enemies into pits, or employing roadblocks in synergy with the terrain, players have the freedom to devise their own tactics. 

The development team is committed to continuous improvement and will eagerly incorporate feedback during the early access phase. Plans for new characters, traps, artifacts, and game modes are in preparation… Player participation during this development stage is encouraged, your valuable opinions will contribute to making Guardians of Holme a better gaming experience!
